notes: PHF HR Competition V1 (Chuong trinh thi dua) go-live: /admin|ql|hv/thi-dua wired into phf-url-router.js. Fingerprint bump is required here because assets/js/phf-url-router.js is served with Cache-Control: immutable, max-age=1y under a query string keyed to this fingerprint — without bumping it, browsers that cached the site before this deploy keep serving the pre-Competition router (no /thi-dua route match), which falls through to the router's default Home redirect. Task business data remains on Company PostgreSQL.
